approvers: Main contractor or developer who sets the subcontract package; owner/director
reason: We use film and tape that cost almost nothing, and the main contractor decides what protection we provide and who pays. I can't take a new supplier at about €19/m2 to my director, and I can't sign that spend anyway.
objection: Film and tape cost well under €1/m2 in material. Nobody on a small house or block job is going to pay about €19/m2, and a 150 m2 minimum is bigger than most of our jobs.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape, applied by our own crew, as the subcontract package requires.
would_change_my_mind: The developer or main contractor writing it into the spec and paying for it themselves, or a price close to film and tape cost.
